displayDescription: IDEA and CONNECTED pieces sprayed onto a night concrete wall, then an arrow, a sprayed node network and a link.up! tag.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (stationary concrete wall; seeded spray clouds, drips, sprayed strokes and nodes redrawn from timeline time)
SVG (Impact/Marker Felt lettering with feDropShadow extrudes and feTurbulence-roughened path masks)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15 paused timeline (sole owner of composition time, mask dash offsets and wrapper transforms)
limitations: Spray paint is approximated with seeded 2D particles and soft radial blooms. There is no fluid, pigment-absorption or pressure simulation.
Drips are procedural growing shapes, not simulated runs.
The concrete wall is procedural noise and seams, not a photographed texture.
Lettering uses locally installed system fonts (Impact, Marker Felt) with fallbacks, so glyph shapes vary if those fonts are missing.
No reviewed preview recipe was supplied, so only the base style implementation is shown.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json had no matched sources or contact sheets, so the background choice is not backed by source-frame evidence.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent. The host QA results are authoritative.
